Police arrest suspect after assault near bus stand

Police in Hisar have arrested an individual accused of assault that occurred near the Purab Pokhra bus stand. The incident followed a dispute that arose after a birthday party. The injured party was brought to the Sadar Hospital. The alleged assault took place near a hotel after the accused reportedly called the victim to the location.
